mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals deteriorating consumer demand and labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of strong PAYEMS growth (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 98.0 (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
